assertion: US traffic deaths fell in the first half of this year to the lowest rate since 2014
independent_value: NHTSA H1 2026 early estimate via Reuters copy: rate 1.02 per 100M VMT; NHTSA's Q1 rate 0.99 was second-lowest Q1 on record (Carscoops)
reason: Early estimate (projection); NHTSA primary page returned 403.

assertion: traffic deaths dropped 2.5% to 16,750 in the first half of the year. It was the lowest number since 2015 and down from 17,175 in the same period last year.
independent_value: 16750/17175 = -2.47%; matches NHTSA release per search results

assertion: This year is on pace to be the fifth straight year of declines
sql: SELECT "year", SUM(fatalities) FROM transport.fatal_crashes GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"
reason: 2025-26 rest on NHTSA estimates; 'on pace' is a projection.

assertion: US traffic deaths jumped 10.8% in 2021 to 43,230, the most in a single year since 2005.
sql: SELECT "year", SUM(fatalities) FROM transport.fatal_crashes GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"

assertion: Full-year traffic deaths for 2025 fell to the lowest number since 2019 and the fatality rate fell to 1.10 fatalities per 100 million vehicle miles traveled, the second-lowest yearly figure in US history
independent_value: Carscoops quoting NHTSA: 2025 lowest since 2019, rate 1.10, second-lowest ever. Warehouse ends 2024 (39,254), consistent.
reason: Early estimate; secondary relay of NHTSA.

assertion: Deaths fell 5% in the first three months of 2026 but just 0.2% in the second three months.
independent_value: NHTSA's own Q1 estimate in July was -4.3% (7,770); the -5% reflects later revision

assertion: bicyclist deaths, which rose 4% to 1,148 last year
independent_value: Carscoops quoting NHTSA: bicyclist deaths rose 4% in 2025 to 1,148
